description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance of five different methods. The horizontal axis contains the categories, ordered from left to right as Standard, Self-RAG, FactTune, CInGS (w/), and CInGS, without an explicit axis label. The vertical axis represents the value and is labeled "Average Performance." It uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with numeric tick marks at regular intervals of 10, and dashed horizontal grid lines extending from each tick mark across the chart area. Additionally, a small grey shaded rectangle is positioned directly on the vertical axis line between the values of approximately 48 and 53. The chart consists of five individual vertical bars, each corresponding to a category and colored differently. The "Standard" bar is orange with an approximate value of 52. The "Self-RAG" bar is tan with a value of roughly 54. The "FactTune" bar is yellow-green and represents the lowest value on the chart at approximately 51. The "CInGS (w/)" bar is steel blue with a value near 53. Finally, the "CInGS" bar is solid blue and represents the highest value at approximately 59. The bars are not sorted by height or alphabetically.
